    {
      "unit": "F000",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary shall make grants to eligible States for the allotments described in subsections (a) and (b), and shall make payments for the grants in accordance with section 6503(a) of title 31.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,

        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 6503(a) of title 31"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In section 9906, the term \"State\" does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this section",
        "scope_quotes": ["F003"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F014",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to a State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall be used by the State to make grants for the purposes described in section 9901 of this title to eligible entities.",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9905", "section 9906", "section 9901"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F017",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (1)", "paragraph (3)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F021",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning on October 1, 2000, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Beginning on October 1, 2000, if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year",
        "scope_quotes": ["F021"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (1)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F023",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "States",
        "actor_quote": "States",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph",
        "scope_quotes": ["F023"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027:F035",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include: (A) providing training and technical assistance to those entities in need of such training and assistance; (B) coordinating State-operated programs and services, and at the option of the State, locally-operated programs and services, targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other organizations funded under this chapter, including detailing appropriate employees of State or local agencies to entities funded under this chapter, to ensure increased access to services provided by such State or local agencies; (C) supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities; (D) analyzing the distribution of funds made available under this chapter within the State to determine if such funds have been targeted to the areas of greatest need; (E) supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals, such as programs supporting individual development accounts; (F) supporting innovative programs and activities conducted by community action agencies or other neighborhood-based organizations to eliminate poverty, promote self-sufficiency, and promote community revitalization; (G) supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and (H) supporting other activities, consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F027"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9905", "section 9906", "subsection (a)", "paragraph (2)", "subsection (c)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F038",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under section 9905 of this title or State allotment received under section 9906 of this title for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities; funds to be spent for such expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant under section 9905 of this title or State allotment that remains after the State makes grants to eligible entities under subsection (a); the cost of activities conducted under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered administrative expenses; and the startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered administrative expenses.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No State may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9905", "section 9906", "subsection (a)", "paragraph (1)(A)", "subsection (c)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F042",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["charity_tax_credit"],
        "statement": "Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit",
        "scope_quotes": ["F042"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (2)", "subsection (b)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F045",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["charity_tax_credit"],
        "statement": "The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before January 1, 1999.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not exceed",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (1)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F049",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "charity_tax_credit",
        "term_refs": ["qualified_charity"],
        "statement": "The term \"charity tax credit\" means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this subsection",
        "scope_quotes": ["F047"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F051:F057",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "qualified_charity",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The term \"qualified charity\" means any organization: (I) that is (aa) described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title, (bb) an eligible entity, or (cc) a public housing agency as defined in section 1437a(b)(6) of this title; (II) that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and (III) if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of such title, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this subsection",
        "scope_quotes": ["F047"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 501(c)(3) of title 26", "section 501(a)", "section 1437a(b)(6) of this title", "clauses (iii) and (iv)", "section 6033", "clause (v)", "section 6033(b)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F061",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["collection_organization", "qualified_charity"],
        "statement": "A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity",
        "scope_quotes": ["F061"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be treated",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F062:F065",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "collection_organization",
        "term_refs": ["qualified_charity"],
        "statement": "The term \"collection organization\" means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title that: solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities; distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and meets the requirements of clause (vi).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this subsection",
        "scope_quotes": ["F047"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 501(c)(3)", "section 501(a)", "clause (vi)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F069",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization meets the requirements of clause (iii) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["clause (iii)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F071",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).",
        "actor": "An organization",
        "actor_quote": "An organization",
        "kind": "exemption",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "scope_text": "for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F071"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not be required",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subclause (I)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F072:F076",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F072", "F076"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be treated",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subclause (I)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F079",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization meets the requirements of clause (iv) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["clause (iv)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F080:F085",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "poverty_program_expense",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For purposes of subclause (I), the term \"poverty program expense\" means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii), but shall not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in section 4911(d) of title 26), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of subclause (I)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F080"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subclause (I)", "clause (iii)", "section 4911(d) of title 26"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F088:F090",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The information required to be furnished under clause (v) about an organization is: (I) the percentages determined by dividing the following categories of the organization's expenses for the year by the total expenses of the organization for the year: expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates; and (II) the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["clause (v)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F092:F094",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The requirements of clause (vi) are met if the organization maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses, and makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization, and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["clause (vi)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F096:F102",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals, the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals",
        "scope_quotes": ["F096:F100"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be treated",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (2)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F105",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under subsection (c).",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": "Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F105"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "no part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subsection (b)(2)", "paragraph (1)", "subsection (c)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F108",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to provide legal services or to provide tuition assistance related to compulsory education requirements (not including tuition assistance for tutoring, camps, skills development, or other supplemental services or training).",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (1)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F111",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["charity_tax_credit"],
        "statement": "No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to supplant non-Federal funds that would be available, in the absence of Federal funds, to offset a revenue loss of the State attributable to a charity tax credit.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (1)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F121",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.",
        "actor": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "actor_quote": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F121"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9905", "section 9906", "subsection (b)", "paragraph (2)"]
      }
    },

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall make grants to eligible States for the allotments described in subsections (a) and (b), and shall make payments for the grants in accordance with section 6503(a) of title 31.
In section 9906, the term "State" does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.

Not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to a State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall be used by the State to make grants for the purposes described in section 9901 of this title to eligible entities.

Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).

Beginning on October 1, 2000, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning on October 1, 2000, if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year

unit_attributes.statement: In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph

unit_attributes.statement: If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include: (A) providing training and technical assistance to those entities in need of such training and assistance; (B) coordinating State-operated programs and services, and at the option of the State, locally-operated programs and services, targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other organizations funded under this chapter, including detailing appropriate employees of State or local agencies to entities funded under this chapter, to ensure increased access to services provided by such State or local agencies; (C) supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities; (D) analyzing the distribution of funds made available under this chapter within the State to determine if such funds have been targeted to the areas of greatest need; (E) supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals, such as programs supporting individual development accounts; (F) supporting innovative programs and activities conducted by community action agencies or other neighborhood-based organizations to eliminate poverty, promote self-sufficiency, and promote community revitalization; (G) supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and (H) supporting other activities, consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a)

unit_attributes.statement: No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under section 9905 of this title or State allotment received under section 9906 of this title for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities; funds to be spent for such expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant under section 9905 of this title or State allotment that remains after the State makes grants to eligible entities under subsection (a); the cost of activities conducted under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered administrative expenses; and the startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered administrative expenses.

Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit

unit_attributes.statement: The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before January 1, 1999.

The term "charity tax credit" means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.

The term "qualified charity" means any organization: (I) that is (aa) described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title, (bb) an eligible entity, or (cc) a public housing agency as defined in section 1437a(b)(6) of this title; (II) that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and (III) if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of such title, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.
A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.
unit_attributes.scope_text: if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity

unit_attributes.statement: The term "collection organization" means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title that: solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities; distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and meets the requirements of clause (vi).

An organization meets the requirements of clause (iii) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.

An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).
unit_attributes.scope_text: for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I)

unit_attributes.statement: Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I)

unit_attributes.statement: An organization meets the requirements of clause (iv) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.

For purposes of subclause (I), the term "poverty program expense" means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii), but shall not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in section 4911(d) of title 26), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.

The information required to be furnished under clause (v) about an organization is: (I) the percentages determined by dividing the following categories of the organization's expenses for the year by the total expenses of the organization for the year: expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates; and (II) the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.

The requirements of clause (vi) are met if the organization maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses, and makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization, and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.

In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals, the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).
unit_attributes.scope_text: In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals

unit_attributes.statement: Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under subsection (c).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2)

unit_attributes.statement: No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to provide legal services or to provide tuition assistance related to compulsory education requirements (not including tuition assistance for tutoring, camps, skills development, or other supplemental services or training).

No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to supplant non-Federal funds that would be available, in the absence of Federal funds, to offset a revenue loss of the State attributable to a charity tax credit.

The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.

unit_attributes.statement: The lead agency shall: (A) develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b); (B) in conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan; and (C) conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914 of this title.

In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.
